defects.quote: Nine out of ten web applications never exceed 100 concurrent writers.
SQLite runs on every phone, so it can obviously handle any web workload.
defects.known_rebuttal: Ubiquity on single-user devices says nothing about server workloads. SQLite allows only one writer at a time per database, so write-heavy multi-user applications hit lock contention, and it has no built-in network access or replication, which multi-server deployments and high-availability setups need.
